title: AIX system must require authentication upon booting into single-user and maintenance modes.
check_content:
Verify that the "root" account has a password assigned:

# cut -d: -f1,2 /etc/passwd | grep root

root:!

If the "root" account is not listed with an "!", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Assign the "root" account a password using passwd command while logged on as "root":
# passwd
VulnDiscussion: This prevents attackers with physical access from trivially bypassing security on the machine and gaining root access. Such accesses are further prevented by configuring the bootloader password.
